parameters.query: INSERT INTO runs (trigger_type, scenario, status, note) VALUES ('manual','B','en_cours','Dérivation intensité de signalement') RETURNING run_id, executed_at;

WITH ins AS (
INSERT INTO validation_queue
  (indicator_id, run_id, period, geo, extractions, consensus_score, source_doc, raw_ref)
SELECT v.indicator_id,
       $1::bigint,
       v.periode,
       'WORLD',
       jsonb_build_object(
         'mesure', 'part des items triés attribués à la question, pertinence >= 1',
         'modele_triage', 'gemini-3.7-flash',
         'consensus', 'non établi — modèle de triage unique (choix mesuré, § 9.5.1) : routage humain systématique',
         'n_pertinents', v.n_pertinents,
         'n_tries', v.n_tries,
         'part_pct', v.part_pct,
         'plancher', '20 items triés/secteur/mois',
         'items', (SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('item_id', a.item_id, 'titre', left(fi.titre, 160)) ORDER BY a.item_id)
                     FROM (SELECT DISTINCT t.item_id
                             FROM flux_triage_ia t
                             JOIN flux_items f2 USING (item_id)
                            WHERE t.sector_code = v.sector_code
                              AND t.watch_question_code = v.watch_question_code
                              AND t.pertinence >= 1
                              AND to_char(f2.date_publication,'YYYY-MM') = v.periode) a
                     JOIN flux_items fi ON fi.item_id = a.item_id)
       ),
       0,
       'flux_triage_ia (vue v_intensite_signalement)',
       'intensite:' || v.sector_code || ':' || v.watch_question_code || ':' || v.periode
  FROM v_intensite_signalement v
 WHERE v.calculable
   AND v.indicator_id IS NOT NULL
   AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM validation_queue q
                    WHERE q.indicator_id = v.indicator_id AND q.period = v.periode)
   AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM indicator_values iv
                    WHERE iv.indicator_id = v.indicator_id AND iv.period = v.periode
                      AND iv.validation_status <> 'rejete')
RETURNING indicator_id, period)
SELECT count(*)::int AS mis_en_file,
       coalesce(string_agg(indicator_id || ' ' || period, ', ' ORDER BY indicator_id, period), 'aucun') AS detail
  FROM ins;

UPDATE runs SET status = CASE WHEN $2::int = 0 THEN 'partiel' ELSE 'ok' END, closed_at = now(), note = 'Dérivation intensité de signalement — ' || $2::int || ' point(s) mis en file de validation (' || $3 || ').' WHERE run_id = $1 RETURNING run_id, status, note;
